D.t: Donald Norcross leads by 32.4 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 93,282 votes; a one point swing is about 1,440 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +24.8 and D +40.1. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
